g.text: Goal calls on behalf of tails and the goal provider
Execs the harness as the agent's OS user
Resolves the credential source_ref at exec: env token, helper, or shared file
Lists, parks, restarts; R55 binary swap in the maintenance slot
Attaches with an exclusive input lease
Asks for one plan (compose-only); compares expect_pin
Hands the composed plan to intake; drives initialize
Sends a launch intent with profile_pin and binding pin
Compare-only pin answer on resume; new plan only for rebuild
Export, seed, reconcile unknown deliveries (opaque refs only)
Rechecks gates before exec; holds the transferred lease
Re-verifies grants and revocation at enqueue and dispatch
Persists fences and the durable inbox
Dispatches only admitted items while the fence is open
Appends events, stores packages and source material
Requests restore after reboot (only automatic requester)
Durable idempotent enqueue; acceptance after host ack
